### 3. Open jobs (all blocked — proposal/vote gates)

All 4 under `data\jobs\` are **open** (`blocked` counts as open in pending-tasks):

| ID | Title | Status | Gate note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job-ms9s7pa0` | Hourly realm snapshots — include pending proposals | `blocked` | `"proposal posted — needs vote"` · voting channel · kind `process` |

**Vote rules** (`governanceClient.mjs` / persona): 75% anytime → implement now; day-7 ≥60% → pass; day-7 <60% → close (reopenable). Features stay proposal-gated; bugs can stage without that gate. Emergency stop would also block new RCON/file-write jobs (not active).
